classes.name: Bard
classes.description: A smooth-tongued teller-of-tales and singer-of-songs who weaves performances into arcane spells, uncovers hidden lore, and disarms with charm.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A divine servant who channels the favor of a chosen deity into healing, protection, and spells granted through prayer and communion.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: A shapeshifter bonded to the spirits of a wild land, able to take animal form and speak with the creatures of the wild.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A hardened warrior built to stand at the front line, wielding a signature weapon and shrugging off wounds others couldn't survive.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A holy warrior bound by vows and quests, commanding divine authority, healing touch, and righteous smiting power.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A hunter and tracker of the wilds, bonded to a loyal animal companion and deadly with called shots at range.

classes.name: Thief
classes.description: A dagger-in-the-dark specialist in traps, locks, poison, and the backstab, living well off the spoils of other people's dungeons.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A fragile but powerful spellcaster who prepares spells from a hand-inscribed spellbook and bends reality through ritual magic.
